root_cause: Checkout requests read Supabase plan state before the existing Stripe configuration precondition. In the current production settings both Stripe server secrets are absent; this storage access is unnecessary and can mask the true billing_not_configured condition.
fix: Keep the existing public plan and customer input validation, but run canonical billingReadiness before any plan-store, checkout-intent or Stripe calls. Preserve full configured-provider, catalog parity, webhook and idempotency logic.
prevention_rule: Never touch billing/customer storage or invoke a payment provider when any required Stripe server configuration is absent; fail closed with 503 billing_not_configured and no writes, no synthetic subscriptions. Re-use the same Brain learning and single production scheduler. A green code release alone does not imply commercial availability.

invariants: no storage or Stripe calls without both keys
